description: Use when the user wants to browse published competitor-vs-competitor breakdowns, or find one involving a specific competitor, rather than fetch one specific comparison by slug. Optionally filter by a competitor name (matches either side). This returns summaries only: to read or quote a comparison, call get_comparison with the item's slug — don't answer from the list. URLs follow https://industry-lens.com/compare/<slug>.

competitor.description: Competitor name filter (matches either side, ILIKE).
